## Eneko Remake

An original, from-scratch Logos recode of Traurige's Eneko, with multi-video rotation, performance/battery awareness and a Japanese-localized settings screen added on top of the original idea: looping video wallpapers behind the Lock Screen, Home Screen and Control Center.

- Independent looping video wallpaper for Lock Screen, Home Screen and Control Center, each with its own volume and zoom toggle
- **Multi-video rotation** (new): drop 2 or more videos into a slot's folder under `/var/mobile/Media/EnekoWallpapers/` and it crossfades between them on a configurable interval, optionally shuffled
- **Performance & battery awareness** (new): auto-pause under thermal pressure and/or below a configurable battery threshold
- Mute automatically while music is playing
- Disable automatically in Low Power Mode
- "Open Wallpaper Folder" shortcut straight into Filza
- Fully localized settings screen (English / Japanese)

- iOS 14.0 or later
- MobileSubstrate / Substitute
- PreferenceLoader
Inspired by the original [Eneko](https://github.com/Traurige/Eneko) by Alexandra (@Traurige). This remake is an independent, from-scratch implementation, not a fork of the original source.

## 1.0.0
- Initial release: independent remake of Eneko
- Lock Screen / Home Screen / Control Center looping video wallpaper, each with its own volume and zoom toggle
- Multi-video rotation with crossfade, per slot
- Auto-pause under thermal pressure and/or low battery
- Mute while music is playing, disable in Low Power Mode
- "Open Wallpaper Folder" shortcut into Filza
- Japanese localization
